source: Debian aom 3.12.1-1, native macOS arm64; independent of archive POC
baseline: unmodified Debian patched source; sizeof-only type_fix is a separate contrast

correctness.mismatch_rule: Any token-attributable mismatch stops; invalid-input statuses and produced visible hashes must agree.
correctness.upstream: CDEF/common, decoder API, test vectors with expected MD5, invalid input, multithread decode, tile, resize/superres, frame size, error resilience; all configured cases in selected groups; exclusions explicit.

memory.measurement: source diagnostic builds; requested boundary bytes and underlying malloc_size including allocator padding; separately report owner/row metadata; harness getrusage ru_maxrss is bytes on macOS
memory.materiality: At 3840x2160 with actual W=8 and W=16, each family must reduce boundary requested bytes by at least 25% versus type_fix; near R~W cases descriptive.
memory.instrumented_time: source CDEF-stage monotonic wall; sum of row synchronization wait intervals including mutex acquisition; pool wait count zero by nonwaiting allocator; not primary timing

timing.order: AB/BA alternating by cell index plus pair index; type_fix=A, token=B
timing.primary_metric: sum of time around aom_codec_decode calls including flush; excludes preload and pixel hashing
timing.analysis: median paired token/type_fix ratio; deterministic percentile bootstrap of median, 50000 resamples, seed 192929 plus cell index, 95% interval
timing.pass: Every primary cell upper 95% bound <=1.02, all hashes/frame counts match, positive CDEF activity.
timing.failure: Any cell lower 95% bound >1.02 => material slowdown STOP; other failure to establish noninferiority => NARROW, never claim no loss.
timing.independent_units: Six constructed workload-family/geometry cells; repetitions are technical, not independent content replications.
timing.host: Run primary timing only after builds, data transfers, correctness and sanitizer jobs finish. No affinity guarantee on macOS; log host load; no data-dependent repeat removal.

sensitivity.method: same ivf_gate executable and timing region, token vs token with nanosleep after each packet; every packet is one frame for generated streams
sensitivity.calibration: separate 960x540 pilot workloads before lock; choose one dose at least 10ms/frame and at least 50% of worst pilot per-frame decode time, rounded up to 1ms; verify predicted ideal dose effect exceeds 8% for each final workload in preconfirmation calibration, increase before freeze if necessary
sensitivity.pass: Each workload median delayed/token >1.08, lower bootstrap 95% bound >1.05, all ratios >1, median excess/dose in [0.5,2], hashes equal.
sensitivity.dose_and_hash_lock: Write protocol.json including exact executable/stream hashes and dose after calibration; hash it BEFORE the first confirmatory pair.

stage_meaning: after top copy before bottom copy
faults.pass: Expected decoder error, destroy succeeds, no deadlock/timeouts (30s), no sanitizer diagnostic, clean decode after each fault matches type_fix; unreachable row and stage negative controls.

paper: NOT_YET until every gate passes; do not write outline
scope: No reference searching, hardware power/energy/area claims, or pooling old measurements.
